# Shop architecture

## Reporting

Could you add a process. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. I want you to put the process on the right side. Also, please never drag the process to the right.

I want you to enlarge the process. After that, i need you to turn it green, but now insert a dashed service in the center. Also, please make the process huge. Also, now bring the process to front.

I need you to label the process auth. Then okay so sketch an end.

Now shift the end a quarter of the way to the top edge, and sketch a client named nginx and then now delete the process. Then shift the client a third of the way to the top edge and okay so add a pink step in the top left.

Lets add 3 hexagons. Please never wrap these hexagons.

Okay so connect the client and the service with an arrow. Measure the latency of the payment path. Lets push the client to the right edge.

Align all hexagons vertically please. Link the client to the end with an orange connector and then could you insert a decision.

## Data layer

Can you join the star to the step. Before that, add a star in the lower right please. After that, can you attach the service to the star.

Lets make the step thick. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to resize the step to medium.

Now add a huge textbox called partner. Print this diagram on a large poster. Okay so change the color of the textbox to teal.

Please link every hexagon to the next one and then please make the step bigger. Would you draw a file next to the step, but can you add four services.

Please move the file a quarter of the way to the bottom edge, and i want you to make the file large and i need you to slide the teal textbox to the left.

Distribute all hexagons evenly horizontally, but do not make the pink step tiny. After that, now copy the step at the top, but push the star halfway to the left edge please, but i need you to duplicate the star.

## Storage

Draw a large box and could you set the color of the decision to teal. Then can you place the decision 120 pixels right of the client. Now connect every hexagon to the next one.

Would you send the end to back. Calculate the monthly cost of the servers. Okay so make the end large.

Would you add a thin actor named signup next to the textbox. Also, i need you to organize all services from the second section in a circle.

I need you to make the end green, but would you connect the end and the file with a large line and then make the end bigger please, and i need you to align the services from section 2 to the left. Could you group these services from the second section into a container called shipping.

Could you make the teal decision solid. Then now sketch 4 databases. After that, i need you to slide the end on the right side. After that, i need you to rename it epsilon. Then can you add a gray rectangle.

## Order flow

Would you sketch a black store called postgres in the top left and then could you grow postgres.

Lets shift the store 150 pixels right of the rectangle. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. I want you to name the store sessions.

Okay so draw a large actor labelled approval. After that, lets link the services from the second section in a chain. Then would you make signup 100 percent bigger. Could you change the color of signup to yellow.

Make the decision thin please. After that, could you make the thin decision large.

I need you to make the teal decision small. After that, make the service from the first section 200 percent smaller and then now scale the first service to tiny, but would you organize the hexagons as a flow from left to right.

Delete every hexagon please. Can you change the color of the decision to yellow, but rename the start to settings please. Before that, sketch a dotted start on the right side please, and please sketch 6 teal diamonds.

Okay so grow settings, but now arrange all services from the second section as a flow from left to right. Please organize everything in a row.

## Analytics

Now add a solid user. Okay so change the color of inventory to orange. Before that, sketch a black store labelled inventory, but could you drag the second store a third of the way to the top edge and then could you rename the store from the fifth section to draft.

Can you connect the second orange store and epsilon with a teal connector. Can you turn the orange store from section 5 teal. Our auditors asked for this view last year. I want you to push the decision from the first section 5 pixels right.

Can you make the first decision small. Send this to the whole team by email. Could you set the color of the service from the first section to purple.

Could you push the service from the first section a third of the way to the bottom edge. Would you clone the first service. After that, lets make the first decision thick. Also, put the start next to the first yellow decision please. Okay so turn the first decision orange.

Now drag the decision from section 1 a third of the way to the bottom edge. Group all diamonds from the fourth section into a container called inventory, and could you connect signup to the black store from the fourth section with an arrow. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Please attach the square to draft. Before that, i want you to add a square.

## Billing

Could you sketch a square named backend above the end. Okay so enlarge backend.

Would you label the second square admin. Could you place the second square in the top right. I need you to rename the second store to invoices.

Could you wrap the teal diamonds from section 4. Please move the gray rectangle on the right side. After that, i need you to join the client to the rectangle. Now distribute the databases evenly vertically.

Align all the databases down please. Also, please wrap the databases. After that, could you place a store inside the start.

I need you to put a solid gateway at the top. After that, i need you to attach every diamond from section 4 to the next one. Also, can you make the actor from the fourth section 20 % bigger. Please put approval right of invoices.

Could you make the decision from the first section 100 % bigger. Lets link settings to the file with a solid arrow.

Would you align all databases vertically. Also, would you connect all the databases in a chain.

## Messaging

Drag the second teal store halfway to the top edge, but i want you to place a blue database above the store from section 5. Then could you drag the second database to the right edge, but can you rename the second database to gamma. Also, okay so put gamma below settings.

Lets shift gamma a third of the way to the left edge. Print this diagram on a large poster. I want you to name it kafka.

Change the color of epsilon to green please. Highlight the risky parts in some way. I need you to resize invoices to medium.

Drag the first decision down. I want you to align the databases from section 3 to the right. Also, i want you to next to the first decision , sketch a solid decision, and connect the store from section 6 and the decision from section 7 with a teal connector. Lets add a red file.

Lets distribute all the diamonds from section 4 evenly vertically and can you attach every database from the third section to the next, and i want you to call the textbox mailer. Send this to the whole team by email. I want you to space all databases from section 3 75 px apart. Also, could you label the third user draft.

## Back office

I need you to sketch 3 orange comments. Then please organize the comments from section 8 as a flow from top to bottom. Play a sound whenever a box appears. I want you to scale the rectangle to medium.

Would you put a caption left of the rectangle. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. I want you to make it small. Then i need you to shift the gray rectangle a third of the way to the top edge, but change the color of the rectangle to blue please. Also, can you delete every orange comment from the eighth section.

Now add a square. Also, i need you to paint the gateway black. Then can you put the gateway in the center and then i need you to turn it orange.

I want you to space the databases from the third section 25 px apart. Then now make the third decision 30 percent smaller.

Would you name the third decision search. Also, okay so resize search to huge.

Okay so create 4 yellow triangles. Also, okay so put the orange gateway inside the file from the second section. After that, i need you to inside the orange gateway , draw a dashed start.

## User accounts

Would you create a gray cache labelled final. Then dont make final 10 % smaller. Call the gray cache gamma. Now make the actor from the fourth section 60 % bigger.

Would you shrink the actor from the third section. I want you to drag the thin actor from the third section a quarter of the way to the top edge. Now grow the file from the seventh section.

Can you group these databases from the third section into a container called refunds. Also, okay so place a blue end in the lower right, and please dont make mailer 150 percent smaller, but please link mailer to the first decision, but enlarge the textbox.

Could you shift the second file up. After that, never paint it purple please. Please scale the second file to large and would you create an ellipse 60 pixels below the second file.

Would you slide the ellipse to the right. Now align the diamonds from section 4 up. Now space the triangles 5 px apart.

I need you to enlarge nginx. After that, okay so right of nginx , create a huge circle. Also, can you place the solid user from section 5 above the circle.

## Monitoring

Can you draw a yellow textbox at the bottom and then i need you to align all databases from the third section to the left. Would you copy mailer.

Lets group the yellow triangles and i want you to turn the file from section 2 black, but could you clone the first black file above the caption. Also, would you distribute all diamonds from the fourth section evenly vertically and then please create four brown ellipses.

Would you paint the square from section 5 green, but sketch a huge start called profile left of the square from the fifth section please, but could you make admin smaller.

Now delete all databases from section 3. After that, add a cloud. Calculate the monthly cost of the servers. Now arrange all diamonds from section 4 in a grid and then distribute the brown ellipses from the tenth section evenly vertically.

I want you to bring the third square to front. Also, i need you to slide the square from the eighth section a quarter of the way to the left edge. Also, please at the top , add a database.

## Search

Would you insert a solid gateway and i want you to make the decision from the first section thick. Also, please right of the store from section 4 , add a hexagon, and wrap all triangles please.

Make profile blue, but do not rename the blue rectangle to mark. After that, connect the third user to the rectangle with a tiny arrow please.

Copy the cloud in the top right. Lets enlarge the first store. Could you join the teal diamonds from the fourth section in a chain. I want you to push the solid user from section 5 fifty pixels right and could you enlarge the third user.

Space the diamonds from the fourth section 120 px apart. The team reviews this flow every quarter. Please change the color of the hexagon to orange. Then could you turn it orange, but can you send the hexagon to back, but would you call the third user pending.

Okay so sketch a thick queue and then i want you to make the gateway from the eleventh section large. Then okay so connect every diamond from section 4 to the next one. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Please join every diamond from the fourth section to the next one, but could you make the decision from the seventh section dashed.

## Payment services

Now add a circle labelled orders and then i want you to bring the second circle to front, and please connect orders to the second gateway with a teal line. Also, please erase the yellow triangles.

Please align the brown ellipses from the tenth section horizontally and i want you to tidy everything as a flow from top to bottom and could you insert a gateway named pricing. Okay so place the gateway from the twelfth section in the top right.

Could you put a medium cloud above the third gateway. After that, sketch 6 stars.

Would you create a purple rectangle labelled beta. Now make the caption 100 percent smaller. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. I want you to shift the caption to the right.

Push the first decision a third of the way to the left edge. Then i want you to scale the purple rectangle from the twelfth section to tiny and would you make the gateway from the sixth section 15 percent smaller. It should look friendly to new customers. I need you to enlarge the gateway from the sixth section, and i want you to join the diamonds from section 4 in a chain.

## Integrations

Lets align all teal diamonds from section 4 horizontally, but could you put the database from section 10 in the top left. Make the database feel more trustworthy. Now make it 5 % smaller.

Scale the database from the tenth section to huge. Then could you add a circle named partner next to the second database. After that, okay so do not drag partner halfway to the bottom edge, and group the ellipses from the tenth section please. I need you to join the diamonds from section 4 one after the other.

I need you to connect the ellipses from section 10 one after the other and place a yellow database in the lower left. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Now make it small. After that, i need you to move it below the square from section 5. After that, i want you to draw a blue caption named worker.

Space all ellipses from the tenth section 40 px apart and attach the diamonds from section 4 in a chain. I want you to make pricing 20 % bigger.

## Notifications

I need you to draw a medium rectangle inside the gateway from the twelfth section. I want you to sketch a caption labelled done. Rotate the whole picture slightly. I want you to shift the caption from the fourteenth section a third of the way to the bottom edge, and can you below the gateway from section 6 , add a title.

Please erase all diamonds from the fourth section. After that, would you make the gateway from the sixth section 60 % smaller, and lets shift the first orange gateway halfway to the top edge.

Lets slide the first gateway in the center. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Would you attach the first gateway to the database from the tenth section.

Please link admin to the gateway from section 6 with an arrow. Translate every label into French. I want you to shift admin to the top edge.

Okay so place admin next to beta. Now resize the square from the sixth section to tiny and then i want you to align the ellipses from the tenth section down, but i want you to send sessions to back. Lets attach the hexagon to the square from section 5 with a yellow line.

## Shipping

I want you to add an ellipse called logger. Could you connect every ellipse from section 10 to the next one. Okay so connect the second decision to the first end. Put a decision on the left side please.

Lets drag the decision from the fifteenth section 75 px above the third store, and now bring the third decision to front. Okay so space the brown ellipses from section 10 120 px apart.

Would you link the yellow database from the thirteenth section to the title with a line and dont slide the third database in the top left please. Please make the decision from section 15 thin. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Please dont grow the third store.

Lets drag the third store fifty pixels left. Write a summary of the design for the board. I want you to slide the third store 75 pixels left. After that, okay so connect the store from the sixth section and the database from section 10 with a line. Lets turn the first decision purple.

Okay so join each ellipse from section 10 to the next one. After that, can you name the first circle tom. I want you to put tom below the start from the eighth section.

## Front end

Could you insert 3 purple titles, but could you make the database from section 13 25 percent bigger.

Okay so add a client in the lower left. Also, i want you to send the client from section 16 to back. Then i want you to bring the client from section 16 to front. Please turn the square from the sixth section yellow. After that, lets push it ten pixels right of logger.

I need you to shift the title from the fourteenth section in the lower right. Would you rename the third store payments. Attach each ellipse from the tenth section to the next one please.

Could you insert three dotted hexagons. I want you to join the first decision to profile, and please connect the hexagons from the sixteenth section in a chain.

Now space the ellipses from section 10 75 px apart. Users love how fast the checkout feels. I want you to make the second end 50 percent smaller.

Label the second end frontend please. Measure the latency of the payment path. Now draw 3 teal queues.

## Review

Now label the third square cart. Make the database feel more trustworthy. I need you to link the third square to the caption from the fourteenth section with a tiny arrow. Then lets make the second store smaller.

Could you delete the second store. After that, please enlarge settings. Then i want you to organize everything in a column, but i need you to add 6 reports and then can you bring the first gateway to front.

Lets align all the hexagons from the sixteenth section up. Then would you resize the second square to huge.

I want you to delete the third user and now join every queue from the sixteenth section to the next, and turn the orange gateway from section 6 pink.

Would you drag the gateway from the sixth section left of profile. Send this to the whole team by email. Okay so drag kafka to the left edge. I need you to create a red store.

I need you to left of the third store , create a title, and i need you to add five dotted actors and then please make the decision from the first section 60 percent smaller. After that, could you sketch a yellow triangle, and connect the yellow triangle and the end from section 9 with a black line.

# Payment system

## Order flow

Can you move the brown gateway a third of the way to the right edge. Before that, would you insert a brown gateway. Write a summary of the design for the board. Lets add a teal task named final right of the gateway, but i need you to draw a thick report 30 px below final.

Please make the brown gateway 75 percent bigger and then i need you to above the report , insert a comment. Users love how fast the checkout feels. Okay so make the comment 30 % smaller and please make the report 40 % bigger. Also, okay so push the report on the left side.

Could you connect the report and the gateway with a connector. Do not connect the report and the comment with a green arrow. I need you to resize the task to tiny. Then could you grow the task.

## Billing

Sketch a brown cache. After that, could you place a cloud on the left side.

Could you sketch an ellipse and then put the ellipse in the lower left please. After that, can you make it bigger.

Could you draw a file on the left side and okay so arrange everything in a grid.

Make final thin please. Also, can you put final five pixels below the report. The marketing team prefers softer colours. I need you to clone the gateway right of the task. Okay so dont connect the ellipse to the cloud with a connector.

Would you rename the ellipse to payments. Please join the file to the cloud, and rename the cache to draft. Then shift draft a third of the way to the bottom edge. Make the task dotted.

Could you shrink final. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Could you call the ellipse accounts. Also, please place the file at the top.

Now never change the color of the file to white. Can you slide the file to the right edge, but i need you to name the cloud alpha.

## Messaging

Now insert a process labelled auth. Translate every label into French. Drag the report to the top edge, but can you connect the file and the comment with a thick line.

Could you connect the file and the comment with a pink connector, and would you tidy everything in a row, but okay so insert a note labelled partner. Encrypt the gateway. Can you draw a service named admin next to the process from the third section.

Okay so attach the square to the cloud. Before that, right of the service , sketch a square.

Would you place a cache in the lower right. Also, i need you to make the second note 15 % smaller.

Can you delete partner. After that, please send the process from the third section to back.

Now clone the second process below the file, but could you turn it brown. Also, i want you to connect final and the square with a connector. Please create a hexagon.

Lets make final small. Then lets connect the hexagon and final with a brown line.

## Monitoring

Now push the hexagon ten px right of accounts and i want you to connect the hexagon and the service with an arrow. Then lets on the left side , add a star.

Now connect the file and the star with a medium connector and then would you change the color of final to green and then okay so move final to the top edge.

Okay so link final to the comment, but please draw a dashed report inside the cache from the second section. After that, lets create 3 white services.

Link the star to final, but shift accounts a third of the way to the left edge.

Distribute the services from the fourth section evenly horizontally please. Also, please tidy everything in a circle.

Okay so put a store next to the ellipse. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. Can you draw a start named postgres, but now align all services from the fourth section down. After that, could you sketch an actor left of the file.

Can you draw a teal gateway named refunds. Then can you slide the diamond a quarter of the way to the top edge. Before that, okay so sketch a white diamond, and okay so space all the services from section 4 50 px apart, but never delete all services from the fourth section.

## Shipping

Could you create a medium cache called delta in the top left. Put a brown customer in the lower left and i need you to move the second customer halfway to the bottom edge. I need you to connect the cache from the fifth section and the customer from the fifth section with a connector.

Could you rename the cache from the fifth section shipping. Lets make the third cache bigger. Also, okay so call the star inventory.

I want you to place a large star left of the first service, but rename the second star to invoices.

Please distribute all services from the fourth section evenly horizontally. After that, change the color of refunds to red please. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Would you draw a green client. Lets make final 25 percent smaller.

Please add 4 files and could you create a huge database inside the first star. After that, could you draw a solid start. After that, can you resize the solid start from the fifth section to small.

Lets attach the start from the fifth section to the first file with a gray arrow, and organize the white services from the fourth section in a circle. After that, i want you to join each service from the fourth section to the next one. After that, now connect the second start to the diamond with a dashed arrow and then lets link the start from section 5 to refunds with a line.

## Payment services

Okay so grow the first file, but i need you to place a queue in the lower right and tidy everything in a grid. It should look friendly to new customers. Align the services from section 4 vertically.

## Storage

Could you link the caption to the title with an arrow, but i want you to enlarge search and i need you to name the caption storage and okay so insert a file called frontend in the center, but i want you to draw a rectangle called tom.

Can you make the caption ten percent bigger. Then would you tidy everything as a flow from top to bottom. Make it look like a subway map. Sketch a start 120 px right of the brown hexagon, but would you change the color of the start to black.

## Monitoring

Would you make payments 60 percent bigger. After that, would you rename the brown hexagon to invoices.

Could you make the start from the third section bigger. Then okay so set the color of the second start to white. After that, can you draw three white steps. Now connect frontend and the title with a connector. Users love how fast the checkout feels. Connect frontend and the title with a solid arrow.

Okay so slide frontend to the top edge. After that, change the color of frontend to white please. Now draw a database named postgres inside frontend. Could you drag the database to the bottom edge and distribute the steps evenly horizontally.

Okay so do not make the first start 20 % bigger. It should look friendly to new customers. I need you to put the first caption in the top right, but could you insert 4 servers. After that, push the second caption to the bottom edge.

## Payment services
